card.name: Linking words in meal and food lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, plus, into, at) right after a meal or food term in dosing directions, where the next word is likely a food or drink word or a time like bedtime.

modes.label: After meal timing
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'at' follows 'before each meal' in dosing schedules.
modes.example: Administer the dosage thirty minutes before each meal<< and>> at bedtime.

modes.label: Lists of food, drink, medication
modes.description: The word 'or' follows 'food, drink,' or 'food, beverage,' in instructions to take a drug first thing.
modes.example: Take FOSAMAX PLUS D at least one-half hour before the first food, beverage,<< or>> medication of the day with plain water only

modes.label: Meals plus snacks
modes.description: The word 'plus' joins three meals to snacks.
modes.example: approximately three meals<< plus>> two or three snacks per day.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward food and drink words such as breakfast, snacks, drinks and food.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in dosing directions that are about to name a meal, snack or drink.
